cards.name: Takama No Hara

effects.printed_clause: Discard exactly 2 cards including a Spirit, then add up to 2 Spirit monsters with different Levels from Deck.
effects.lua_implementation: The activation verifies a two-card discardable subgroup containing a Spirit; resolution discards exactly two as effect, then selects one or two Deck Spirits whose Level class count is distinct and adds/confirms them.

official_references.matched_structure: Ursarctic Departure uses discard followed by multi-card archetype search; subgroup checks enforce composition.
official_references.official_effect_text: [b]Discard[/b] 1 card; add 2 "Ursarctic" monsters from your Deck to your hand. If you would Tribute a monster(s) to activate an "Ursarctic" monster's effect, except the turn this card was sent to the GY, [b]you can[/b] [b]banish[/b] this card from your GY [b]instead[/b]. [b]You can[/b] only use each effect of "Ursarctic Departure" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b].

effects.printed_clause: Banish this from GY, target a Spirit you control; it cannot return to hand by card effect until End Phase.
effects.lua_implementation: The selected face-up Spirit receives EFFECT_CANNOT_TO_HAND through the End Phase; this enforces the destination but the core prohibition is reason-agnostic. Adversarial re-review confirmed this remains non-exact. Adversarial re-review confirmed this remains non-exact.

official_references.matched_structure: Official movement-control scripts use single-card destination effects and phase resets.
official_references.official_effect_text: If this card is in your GY: [b]You can[/b] place 1 card from your hand on the top of the Deck; Special Summon this card, but [b]banish[/b] it [b]when[/b] it leaves the field.

effects.issue: EFFECT_CANNOT_TO_HAND is reason-agnostic, so the current Lua also blocks returning the target as a cost. Master Rule Omega has no EFFECT_CANNOT_TO_HAND_EFFECT equivalent that limits the prohibition to card effects. Resolution: remove 'by card effect' from the text, or add an effect-only hand-return prohibition to the engine and use it in c229996802.lua.

effects.printed_clause: Each effect is once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: Activation and GY effect use id/id+100.

official_references.matched_structure: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring supplies named HOPT structure.
official_references.official_effect_text:
[b]When[/b] a card or effect is activated that includes any of these effects ([b]Quick Effect[/b]): [b]You can[/b] [b]discard[/b] this card; [b]negate[/b] that effect.
● Add a card from the Deck to the hand.
● Special Summon from the Deck.
● Send a card from the Deck to the GY.
[b]You can[/b] only use this effect of "Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b].

cards.audit_note: Confirmed an unresolved reason-filtering limitation in destination prohibitions.
